postconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of cities n is between 2 and 3000, inclusive.
Each road connects two cities with numbers between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: r is the minimum possible number of roads assigned to the most used company.
postconditions.description: The output r is the minimum number of roads that any company will have to repair.

postconditions.expression: c_i indicates the company to repair the i-th road.
postconditions.description: The output c_i is the company number assigned to repair the i-th road.
